artifacts.summary: Six-phase mechanical application pass replacing hand-enumerated TruthAt simp lists with simp only [truth_norm] / [swap_norm] across Soundness.lean and FrameClassVariants.lean.

memory_candidates.content: Planning a simp-set adoption pass in Lean 4: before sizing phases, classify every call site into (A) lists naming only the set's own lemmas, which are goal-identical drop-ins, and (B) lists that also name syntax-unfolding lemmas (Formula.and/neg/or/swapTemporal), which are NOT drop-ins. simp rewrites bottom-up, so the syntax lemma fires on the argument before the head-matching characterization lemma can match; adding the set to such a list is a no-op, and removing the syntax lemmas changes the goal shape so the proof body below must be rewritten. Confirm the split empirically with lean_multi_attempt at 2-3 representative sites at PLAN time - it converts phase sizing and the risk table from guesswork into measurement, and it reveals whether the completion metric is reachable from class A alone (giving class B a safe exclusion path).
